profile.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer • Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript, Go • Civic Tech & Healthcare Systems
profile.summary: I’m a mission‑driven Software Engineer with 9+ years of full‑stack experience leveraging software to create effective platforms for diverse populations. Skilled in accessibility, picking up new tools, and building scalable services for millions of users. I’ve built inclusive digital platforms mainly for government agencies and nonprofits.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
∙ Shipped fullstack features across a Rails 8.1 and React platform powering benefits administration for employers
∙ Designed Calendly scheduling URL integration with validation, normalization, and HubSpot sync via after_commit callbacks
∙ Developed ActiveAdmin panels and survey form submission systems
∙ Resolved performance bottlenecks through N+1 query optimization
∙ Maintained frontend component systems with SCSS and Bulma
∙ Wrote robust test coverage including PostgreSQL time-stubbing strategies for time-dependent logic
• Time was cut short due to sudden budget constraints and mass layoff.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby on Rails · React.js · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
∙ Built the Montana WIC eligibility screener, enabling families to quickly determine benefits eligibility and streamlining the application process
∙ Developed and maintained the Beneficiary Claims Data API (BCDA), a FHIR-based API serving Medicare/Medicaid claims data to Accountable Care Organizations
∙ Contributed to BCDA backend services in Go, including work on data filtering, API reliability, and Terraform-managed infrastructure
∙ Monitored system health and performance using New Relic dashboards and NRQL queries
∙ Built and maintained features on CMS Medicaid and Medicare portals
∙ Contributed to VA Caseflow, a case management system supporting veterans’ benefits appeals
∙ Led an accessibility refactor on the Vermont MABD enrollment experience, implementing jest-axe testing and VoiceOver screen reader validation
∙ Worked across a diverse stack including Ruby on Rails, React, Go, Python/Flask, AWS, Docker, and Terraform
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AngularJS · React.js · MongoDB · PostgreSQL · Ruby on Rails · Flask · Python (Programming Language) · Node.js · TypeScript · Redis · Next.js · Amazon S3 · Amazon ECS · Amazon EC2 · New Relic · Splunk · Jenkins · CircleCI

positions.title: Product Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to Ruby/Rails platform. My time here was cut short due to the pandemic.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Partnered with NREL (National Renewable Energy Laboratory) to build full-stack features in Flask, Rails, and Vue; migrated Angular/Rails monolith to Vue, improving maintainability and performance.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
- Built front-end interfaces for React web and React Native apps
- Spearheaded and automated QA process using Selenium and Mocha

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Scoped, developed, and led internationalization of the state's voter registration site; ensured support for Spanish speaking populations. 
- Built and maintained legacy Java/Primefaces full stack applications.

positions.title: Community Outreach Specialist
positions.description: Developed awareness for Children International, a charitable non-profit benefitting youth in developing countries. Responsibilities included public speaking, preparing an informational presentation on global poverty once a week, and traveling to offices in different cities for week-long intervals. Via public outreach, I effectively persuaded individuals from diverse backgrounds to become charity donors.
